reason: The package graph lets @specstride/host-claude-code import @specstride/contracts AT BUILD TIME ONLY. mayImport separates packages and cannot express that qualifier, so the module-level half stands here (F149-FR-007): packages/host-claude-code/src/shim/ is the one part of src/ that is rendered into plugin/bin/ and runs on the consumer's machine, and the plugin layer carries no run-time dependency (F113-FR-030, F113-FR-031, threat T-44). The shim inlines the protocol integer and the refusal line of annex H section H.1, and a test of T007 holds them against @specstride/contracts/ep/host.
